items.mainDefect: The Bigin refresh passes credential.id instead of credential.userId to refreshOAuthTokens, so the sync endpoint gets the wrong user.

secondary.defect: The Bigin caller treats the fetch Response returned when sync is enabled as an axios response and reads .data on it.

items.mainDefect: The Salesforce CalendarService is missing the prisma import, which causes a runtime ReferenceError.

secondary.defect: The Salesforce Connection is created with the stale credentialKey access token instead of the refreshed token and instance_url.
The refresh response is checked with statusText instead of response.ok.

items.mainDefect: symmetricDecrypt and JSON.parse in the app-credential webhook can throw uncaught, which gives a 500 instead of a 400.

secondary.defect: parseRefreshTokenResponse injects a placeholder refresh_token that gets saved, and later real refreshes fail with invalid_grant.

items.mainDefect: refreshOAuthTokens checks the numeric userId by truthiness instead of an explicit != null check.

secondary.defect: createOAuthAppCredential uses a truthiness check on state?.teamId instead of != null.

items.mainDefect: decodeOAuthState calls JSON.parse(req.query.state) with no try/catch, so invalid state crashes the OAuth callback with a 500.

secondary.defect: encodeOAuthState has the same unguarded JSON.parse of req.query.state.

items.mainDefect: symmetricDecrypt and JSON.parse in the app-credential webhook are outside any try/catch, so bad keys or payloads cause an unhandled 500.

secondary.defect: The webhook request body is validated with zod .parse instead of .safeParse, so invalid bodies throw instead of returning 400.

items.mainDefect: The Google calendar refresh reads res?.data on the fetch Response returned when sharing is enabled, so token is undefined and token.access_token throws.

secondary.defect: HubSpot, MS Teams, Webex and similar callers expect a parsed token object but get a fetch Response.

items.mainDefect: The Bigin refresh passes credential.id instead of credential.userId to refreshOAuthTokens.

secondary.defect: The Bigin caller reads .data without handling the fetch Response vs axios response shapes.

items.mainDefect: The Bigin caller expects an axios {data} response but the sync path returns a fetch Response, so tokenInfo.data is undefined.

secondary.defect: The Bigin caller passes credentialId where refreshOAuthTokens expects userId for calcomUserId.
